activity_summary: The morning was the queen's entrance into the garden. Kemp was not on the plot. You kept the king out of the scene, and you did not put a fool in to keep the peace. Sixteen days stand before the yard. Nick took two paces toward where the shadow would be. Phillips was in the house for his own roll. This pass was not his, and Verona was not in anyone's mouth.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Set Nick in the shadow, and kept the king and the fool out.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Asked not to be furniture, and sat the pass out on the stair.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Took two paces, and went quieter.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Gave him the two paces, and played the hedge.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Wrote no fool and no margin, and left Kemp off the plot.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: In the house for his roll. This pass was the garden. He was not told anything of the other play.

entities.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope
entities.context: In the door. They did not speak, and they were to have it back.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Not sent for. The plot was left to answer him.

entities.name: sixteen days
entities.context: Mentioned in The garden, and no fool

facets.activity: Gave the entrance to Nick and the hedge to Pope

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: Kemp is not on the plot, and I have not sent for him.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The king is not in this garden, Dick.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not putting a fool in this king to keep the peace.
